description: Schema for youth data import to youth-permission-tracker system
notes: This schema defines the data structure for loading youth accounts into the system via the /youth API endpoint.

first_name.validation: Non-empty string, alphanumeric with spaces/hyphens allowed

last_name.validation: Non-empty string, alphanumeric with spaces/hyphens allowed

group.notes: Auto-assigned by extract_from_pdf.py based on gender and age. Can be manually overridden.

gender.notes: Used to determine group assignment. Not stored in database, informational only.

birth_date.notes: Optional in Phase 1. Used for age calculation and group assignment. Stored for future reference.

phone.notes: Extracted from PDF if available. Not used by /youth endpoint but stored for records.

email.notes: Extracted from PDF if available. Not used by /youth endpoint but stored for records.

grouping_rules.note: Secondary group affiliation (YM, YW) is implicit and not stored in /youth endpoint

validation_rules.group: Required, must be one of: Priest, Teacher, YM, YW
validation_rules.uniqueness: Combination of (first_name, last_name) should be unique; duplicate usernames will be rejected by API with 409 Conflict

phase_2_note: Future enhancement: Use /users endpoint to submit complete medical/permission data. Required fields for Phase 2 will include: permission_code, parent_guardian info, medical history, emergency_contact, and signature image.
